svg.text: Q1: two fillets on opposite edges, radii 3 and 3 on a 4 wide face (r1 + r2 > w)
what the rule gives and what the alternatives would give; every volume is the analytic section extruded
A. intersection of the rounded profiles (CHOSEN)
each arc tangent to its wall; the arcs cross on the face
between them (141 deg). Order does not matter.
Same rule as r1 + r2 = w, continuous in r.
B. decline (what 8.0.1 does)
IsDone false: nothing is built
IsDone false. Safe, and the caller can retry
with a smaller radius. Discontinuous: r = 2 builds,
r = 2.001 does not.
C. clamp the radii to fit (2 and 2)
both radii scaled so that r1 + r2 = w: a smooth
top, but not the radius that was asked for;
the result no longer depends on what was typed.
D. first radius wins (3, then 1)
the second radius is cut to what is left (w - r1).
Depends on the order the edges were added.
